title: Hokey Pokey Ice Cream
description: New Zealand vanilla ice cream studded with crunchy golden-syrup honeycomb. A no-churn, egg-free home version.

steps.instruction: Line a tray with parchment. Heat caster sugar and golden syrup over medium-low heat until melted and bubbling, about 4–5 minutes; do not stir aggressively.
Remove from heat, quickly stir in baking soda once, and immediately pour the foaming honeycomb onto parchment. Keep clear of the hot sugar.
Cool the honeycomb completely for about 30 minutes, then break into pea-sized shards.
Whip the cold cream until soft peaks form. Fold in condensed milk and vanilla without deflating the mixture.
Fold in most of the honeycomb, reserving a little for topping. Transfer to a covered freezer container and freeze until firm, at least 6 hours.
Let soften for 5 minutes, scoop and sprinkle with the remaining honeycomb.
